paragraphs.text: Thank you for choosing Fenster Glazing to support you on this project.
Client: Elkins Construction

FAO: Trevor Copeman
Project Reference: Brandon Estate EWI Remediation Works
Site Address:  Brandon Estate, John Ruskin Street, London SE5 0XF
Executive Summary

Fenster Glazing are pleased to submit our proposal for the replacement of 1,325 windows at Brandon Estate, John Ruskin Street, London SE5, as part of the wider building safety and refurbishment programme.

Constructed during the 1960s, the estate is undergoing a comprehensive phased upgrade to improve the performance and compliance of the external envelope. As the existing windows form an integral part of the wall construction, their replacement is a key element in achieving the required fire safety objectives and supporting the approval of the overall façade remediation works.

Our proposal comprises the supply and installation of modern aluminium casement windows designed to meet current performance standards whilst respecting the character and appearance of the existing buildings. Through a carefully planned phased approach, Fenster Glazing will work collaboratively with the wider project team to minimise disruption to residents while maintaining programme certainty, quality, and safety throughout the duration of the works.

With extensive experience delivering large-scale occupied refurbishment projects, we understand the importance of coordination, communication, and consistent workmanship, ensuring the successful delivery of this significant estate-wide improvement programme.
For a full breakdown of costs please refer to our relevant pricing document.
Project Approach
Technical Review & Survey

Following appointment, Fenster Glazing will review all project documentation and undertake a detailed site survey to verify dimensions, interfaces and installation requirements. Any discrepancies or technical queries identified will be raised and resolved prior to manufacture.
Procurement & Manufacture

Materials will be procured through our established supply chain following survey completion and approval of all relevant information. Fabrication drawings will be produced where required to support manufacture and installation activities.
Project Management

A dedicated Project Manager and Installation Manager will be assigned to oversee the works from award through to completion. Pre-start meetings, regular progress updates and proactive communication ensure effective coordination throughout the project.
Installation

Installation works will be undertaken by experienced glazing operatives in accordance with project-specific RAMS, agreed site phasing and Principal Contractor requirements. Particular consideration is given to working within occupied buildings and live environments where disruption must be minimised.
Quality Assurance & Handover

Quality inspections are undertaken throughout survey, manufacture and installation activities in accordance with our QA procedures. Upon completion, internal snagging inspections will be carried out prior to handover, with all relevant warranties, O&M information and project documentation provided as part of the close-out process.
Previous Projects
Further Completed Projects can be found on our website: fensterglazing.com/commercial
Project Delivery Team
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Consumer Notice

Where the client is acting as a consumer, nothing in these Terms and Conditions shall affect the client’s statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 or related consumer protection legislation.

Quotation Validity
All quotations provided by Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd are valid for 30 days from the date of issue, unless agreed otherwise. All quotations are subject to final site survey and measurement verification.

Deposit and Payment Terms
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd requires receipt of a Purchase Order or a deposit of 50% of the total quotation value prior to commencement of works, in order to secure scheduling and procurement of materials. The remaining 50% balance is due upon completion of installation and client sign-off.
Late Payment

All invoices are payable in accordance with the terms above. Any sums not paid within 30 calendar days of the invoice date will be considered overdue and will attract interest at the statutory rate of 4% per annum above the Bank of England base rate, applicable at the time.

Guarantee and Warranty
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd provides a 10-year warranty covering all glass and frame products supplied and installed by the company. This warranty covers defects in materials (as supplied) and workmanship (installation). Furthermore, this warranty is subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable manufacturer warranties. It does not cover damage resulting from misuse, accidental or intentional damage, vandalism, inadequate or incorrect maintenance, or external factors, including severe weather conditions.

Order Confirmation & Site Survey
Upon receipt of a valid Purchase Order, the quotation shall be converted into an order confirmation. A site survey shall then be undertaken to verify final measurements and site conditions. Where required, the order confirmation shall be updated and reissued to reflect verified measurements or agreed amendments.

A sign-off sheet will be issued for client approval prior to manufacture or procurement of materials. Any changes to specifications, measurements, or costs identified as a result of the site survey or client-requested amendments shall be confirmed in writing and agreed prior to proceeding.

Manufacture, Delivery, and Installation
Manufacture and procurement of materials shall commence only following receipt of the signed sign-off sheet. Once manufacture has commenced, changes or cancellations may not be possible and, where accommodated, may be subject to additional costs and revised lead times.

Upon completion of manufacture, goods shall be delivered either to Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd’s warehouse or directly to site, as agreed. Installation shall be carried out by Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd in accordance with the agreed order confirmation and programme.
Installation dates are indicative and subject to site readiness, access, and the client fulfilling its obligations.

Supplier Delays and Liability
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall not be liable for delays, additional costs, losses, or consequential damages arising from delays, defects, or errors caused by third-party suppliers or manufacturers.

Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd will use reasonable endeavours to mitigate the impact of such delays and shall keep the client informed of any material changes to programme or availability. Where reasonably possible, alternative solutions may be proposed for the client’s consideration.

Site Access and Conditions
The client shall be responsible for ensuring that safe, clear, and uninterrupted access to the installation site is available during agreed working hours and that site conditions are suitable for the works to proceed.

Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd reserves the right to suspend works where suitable access or site conditions are not provided. Any additional costs incurred as a result of restricted access, inadequate site conditions, or delays beyond Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd’s control may be charged to the client.

Health and Safety
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall carry out all works in accordance with applicable UK health and safety legislation. The client shall be responsible for ensuring that the site and working environment comply with all relevant health and safety requirements, including the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015.
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd reserves the right to suspend works without penalty where site conditions are deemed unsafe or non-compliant with applicable health and safety requirements.

Cancellation and Postponement
Should the client cancel or postpone the contract following procurement of materials or commencement of works, Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd reserves the right to retain the deposit and recover any additional costs incurred up to the date of cancellation or postponement.
All goods supplied by Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd are bespoke or made to order, and retention of the deposit reflects costs incurred in procurement, manufacture, and administration.

Force Majeure
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall not be liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations under this agreement where such failure or delay arises from events or circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, extreme weather conditions, industrial action, government restrictions, pandemics, or significant supply chain disruption.
Limitation of Liability

To the extent permitted by law, Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd’s total liability arising out of or in connection with the contract shall be limited to the total contract value. Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, or loss of business.
Nothing in these Terms and Conditions shall limit or exclude liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any matter which cannot lawfully be excluded.

Retention of Title
All materials supplied by Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall remain the property of Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd until payment has been received in full.

Intellectual Property
All design work, drawings, plans, and bespoke glazing system solutions provided by Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd shall remain the intellectual property of Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd unless otherwise agreed in writing.
The client shall not reproduce or permit use of such materials by third parties without prior written consent.
Design Responsibility

Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd is not responsible for overall design intent, architectural suitability, or regulatory strategy and relies on information, drawings, and specifications provided by the client or their professional team. Responsibility is limited to measurement verification, supply, and installation of the agreed glazing systems.

Dispute Resolution
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd aims to resolve any disputes amicably and professionally. Where a dispute cannot be resolved through informal discussion, the parties shall first seek to resolve the matter through mediation by an independent mediator agreed between them, prior to commencing any legal proceedings.
Nothing in this clause shall prevent either party from seeking urgent injunctive or interim relief.

Governing Law and Jurisdiction
These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. The parties agree to submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales in relation to any dispute arising out of or in connection with these Terms and Conditions.

Acceptance
By engaging Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd for the supply of goods and provision of installation services, the client confirms acceptance of these Standard Terms and Conditions, unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing.

Amendments to Terms and Conditions
Fenster Glazing & Locks Ltd reserves the right to amend these Terms and Conditions from time to time. Where any material amendments are made, clients will be notified in writing.
Any amendments shall apply to future contracts only and shall not affect existing agreements unless agreed in writing.
